method: Unchanged original classes on the DifficultyProbe world double (Normal), which lists entities whose boxes meet a query box and logs spawned entities and sounds. pushable: Entity.canBePushed. push: EntityLivingBase.collideWithNearbyEntities of a with b beside it (motion of both after). hurt: EntityLivingBase.attackEntityFrom per step (the counters hurtTime, hurtResistantTime and recentlyHit run down between steps as onEntityUpdate does), then 20 onDeathUpdate ticks; drops are the EntityItems onDeath spawns, xp the EntityXPOrb values. Entity.rand and World.rand are seeded. split: EntityXPOrb.getXPSplit.
